description: The AH-31 Kukri is a 6.2-tonne twin-engine medium attack helicopter flown primarily by the Boscali Defense Force for national defense and close air support. It pairs an advanced nose-mounted sensor suite and small multimode radar with a 20mm rotary cannon fed from an 1,100-round magazine at 1,200 rounds per minute. It is an efficient, hard-hitting platform in terms of cost-to-performance, but relies on robust armor and sheer firepower rather than the stealth of designs like the Chicane.
